en.title: Get Maximum Efficiency
en.description:
Choose one activation window [t1,t2] and run every test case that arrives within this closed interval. The efficiency is the number of executed cases minus the duration t2−t1; multiple cases with the same arrival time are all executed, and the answer may be negative.

This site's standard input/output protocol and the supplementary limits noted in the statement are this site's judging conventions; they do not imply that the original OA platform provided the same protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n (2≤n≤200000), and the second line contains n arrival times, 1≤arrivalTime[i]≤1000000000.
en.output: Output the maximum efficiency achievable while processing at least two test cases.
en.explanation: See the accompanying solution for the approach, the proof of correctness, and the complexity.
hints: Start by identifying the invariants, the boundaries, and the conditions in the rules that must hold at the same time.
